title: …Against the Evil Might of Dooku
front_description: "Powerful you have become. Dooku. The dark side I sense in you," Yoda tells the Count as they hold each other at bay with amazing Jedi assaults. The renegade Dooku continues to hurl Force lightning at Yoda. who deftly absorbs and deflects the blasts. "I have become more powerful than any Jedi. Even you," he sneers, rallying for a blow.
back_description: Christopher Lee, famed for his portrayals of Dracula, strikes a menacing pose.
